text: If you’re on a bicycle, you want to get to\nyour destination as quickly as possible, right?\r\nThat’s why we race!

What is the problem with those Team Yell goons?\c
I can understand wanting to cheer someone on,
but they cause so much trouble in the process!
Hardly a decent way for fans to behave.
That big building you see in the distance is\nHammerlocke Stadium!\r\nYou’re going to battle there, too!

The secret to preparing an amazing meal is
stirring it just right, over the perfect heat!\c
You know you’re doing great if the top of
the pot starts sparkling.\c
Why not stop by my camp and practice cooking
a bit?
